item.title: Expertise and Innovation in Printer Cartridge Solutions
item.description:
Expertise and Innovation in Printer Cartridge Solutions
#

Cartridge Web™ (CW) stands as a distinguished printer cartridge brand established by General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. (GPI), a company with over three decades of leadership in the printer cartridge manufacturing sector. GPI is publicly traded on the Taiwan stock market, reflecting its stability and industry recognition.

item.title: Company Values and Global Presence in Imaging Supplies
item.description:
Company Overview and Vision
#

General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. (GPI ) stands as a leading manufacturer and supplier in the imaging supplies sector. Established in 1978, GPI is headquartered at 50, Tzu-Chiang Rd., Wu-Chi District, Taichung City, Taiwan 43546. With a workforce of over 500 employees, the company has achieved a revenue milestone of 60 million US dollars as of December 31, 2017.
